name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration and development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study, targeting first production in 2029. The company also holds a joint venture interest in the La Coipita project in San Juan, Argentina, in partnership with Teck.
